multiple_testing_family: all 48 associations (2 slices x 12 programs x 2 relationships)
covariates: rank(log1p(total UMI)), rank(n_genes), rank(percent mitochondrial RNA), intercept
null_model: independent random sign flips of coefficients in the complete eigenbasis of H W H, W symmetric binary hex first-neighbor adjacency. Preserves target residual graph spectral power, centered norm and Moran I. This is a model-based exploratory null, not an exact distribution-free patient-level test.
expression: PGAM5 log1p(CP10k) including zeros; programs average gene log1p(CP10k)
neighbor: arithmetic mean over observed QC-passing first-ring hex neighbors; zero-neighbor spots excluded
not_estimated: cell-type fractions, validated PGAM5-positive macrophage abundance, cell-cell ligand-receptor interactions
numerical_ties: Expression and program values rounded to 12 decimal places before ranking; float64 CSV serialization preserves source values.
